PARADEOF THEDEAD

You're the zombie. Eat the building. Climb the floors. Steal their talents.

Steer: drag anywhere (WASD or arrows on a keyboard). You never stop moving.

Eat: run your head into people. Each one joins the mob behind you and gives you a power that stacks.

Climb: eat enough on a floor and the stairwell opens. Some stairwells are locked: eat the keycard holder, or hold both pressure plates with your mob.

They fight back: people warn each other, run for the exits, throw things, and shove furniture at you. Corner a gym bro and he'll swing. Security shoots straight. Hunters lay bear traps and fire piercing bolts after a laser sight. Flame troopers torch the mob. Grenadiers lob grenades: watch the landing marker.

The mob: anyone who touches it gets eaten, and zombies lunge out to grab people nearby. But kill a zombie mid-line and everything behind it breaks off as strays — they wander, get hunted down by people with whatever's to hand, and you have to walk back to collect them. Shooters go for strays and the tail first.

Surge: every 12 people you eat, the mob goes into a frenzy for three seconds: longer lunges, faster feet. Aim it at a crowd, not at a gun.

Survive: no healing: eating barely heals, so HP comes from Beefy and Vitality. Traps pin you and the back of the mob gets picked off. Lab laser fences cycle on and off: time it. Stay off fire and acid.
